g.text: CURT Backend — Register / Sign Up Request Architecture & Error Mapping
PRECISE EXECUTION PIPELINE & EXACT ERROR ORIGIN TRACKING
If valid ➔ calls next() to Controller
Expires in 7 days + unique jti UUID
Used when username or email is taken
• Queries DB for email OR user

svg.text: SUCCESS RETURN: HTTP 201 Created (JSON Body + HttpOnly Cookie)

g.text: 4 DISTINCT ERROR ORIGINS & SEPARATE EYE-FRIENDLY ERROR CHANNELS
• Trigger: Client IP makes >10 signups / 15 mins
• Defense: Protects against automated spam bot creation
• Trigger: Weak password, invalid email, short user
• Action: Catches ZodError & maps exact field issues
• Trigger: Email or username already registered
• Action: Stops registration transaction before DB insert
• Trigger: Supabase PostgreSQL outage, network drop
• File: config/db.ts or unhandled runtime bug
• Action: Masks sensitive stack trace in production
